The work in SAMT-BU takes place in the GitHub organisation [samt-x](https://github.com/samt-x). Everything that is published can be read by anyone, even without an account. To contribute, have tasks assigned to you and see what is not public, you need to be a member of the organisation.

## Joining the work

1. **Create a GitHub account** at [github.com](https://github.com/signup) if you do not already have one. It is free
2. **Send your username** (not your email address) to someone in the core team, and say which work you will take part in, for example a pilot or a subject team
3. **Accept the invitation.** It arrives by email, and can also be found on GitHub under your profile picture → Settings → Organizations. You can open it directly at [github.com/orgs/samt-x/invitation](https://github.com/orgs/samt-x/invitation). **The invitation expires after seven days.** Let us know if it has expired, and we will send a new one

Once you are in, you can edit on the site, see the boards and have tasks assigned to you. Where to find your tasks is described in [Tasks and follow-up](https://docs.samt-bu.no/en/prosjektstyring/oppgaver-og-oppfolging/).

## What you get access to

Access is granted to teams, not to individuals. You are added to the team for the work you take part in, and get:

- write access to the shared site content, the drafts and the document archive, which all participants have
- write access to the repository of your own team or pilot

If you take part in more than one piece of work, you are added to several teams.

## Who decides

This arrangement applies for the time being:

- **Anyone can propose new participants.** Send the proposal to someone in the core team
- **The core team approves** new participants and removes those who are no longer part of the work. Anyone in the core team can do this
- **The owners of the organisation** have full access everywhere and handle what requires owner permissions in GitHub. Members can see who the owners are under People in the organisation

A shared overview of roles and tasks in the governance and administration of the ecosystem is being worked on in [samt-bu-architecture#34](https://github.com/samt-x/samt-bu-architecture/issues/34). Once it exists, it replaces the arrangement above.

## For administrators

The core team keeps a member list that is not public, and checks it against GitHub. The procedure for bringing in, following up and removing participants is described in [Managing members and access](https://docs.samt-bu.no/en/prosjektleveranser/loesninger/samhandlingsplattform/samt-bu-docs/teknisk-dokumentasjon/medlemmer-og-tilgang/).
